# everyDock v1.1.0 — New windows and in-app updates

A feature release that adds Shift-click new windows and an update window. Existing Dock behavior and saved settings are unchanged.

## What's new since v1.0.0

- **Shift-click opens a new window.** Shift-click a running app to run its own New Window command, such as Finder’s **New Finder Window** or a browser’s new window. Apps whose Command-N creates something else, such as a calendar event, a file, or a chat, are only brought forward, with a beep. A stopped app launches as with a normal click. Window control needs Accessibility access, as before.
- **everyDock tells you when an update is out.** From this version, everyDock checks the latest GitHub release at launch and after wake, at most once a day, without delaying startup. The update window shows the new and current versions with release notes and offers **Skip This Version**, **Later**, and **Yes**. For a Homebrew installation, **Yes** opens Terminal, quits everyDock so the macOS Dock is restored, and runs `brew update` and `brew upgrade --cask hungryZoo/tap/everydock`, keeping your settings. Manual installations get the release page. Use **Check for Updates…** in the menu bar menu to check now, or turn off automatic checks in **Settings → Updates**. The only data sent is the app version in the request header.
- **Blank icons recover on their own.** Icons that lost their image now keep the last good image or show a placeholder while everyDock reloads the artwork.

This release remains **ad-hoc signed and not notarized**.

## Upgrading from v1.0.0 or earlier

Earlier versions have no update check, so update once from Terminal. Quit everyDock first:

```bash
brew update
brew upgrade --cask hungryZoo/tap/everydock
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/everyDock.app
open -a everyDock
```

Upgrade preserves settings; uninstall and reinstall reset them. Later releases can be installed from the update window.

## Install

Install Homebrew first, then run:

```bash
brew install --cask hungryZoo/tap/everydock
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/everyDock.app
open -a everyDock
```

For a manual installation, download `everyDock-1.1.0-arm64.zip` and `SHA256SUMS` from this release and verify them in the same directory with `shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS` before extracting the app.
